title: Neural Evolutionary Kernel Method: A Knowledge-Guided Framework for Solving Evolutionary PDEs
summary: Numerical solution of partial differential equations (PDEs) plays a vital role in various fields of science and engineering. In recent years, deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful tool for solving PDEs, leveraging their approximation capabilities to handle complex domains and high-dimensional problems. Among these, operator learning has gained increasing attention by learning mappings between function spaces using DNNs.
